SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEP_PO01 WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'PTEC' AS BUYER, NVL(COMPANY_CODE,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE_UNIT,0) AS UNIT_QTY, NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(REPLACE(ADD_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(REPLACE(RD_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(PUR_CRE_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, NVL(PUR_USER_ID,' ') AS REQ_USER_ID, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_TEL,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, NVL(REQ_USER_HP,' ') AS REQ_USER_HP, NVL(REQ_USER_TEL,' ') ||'/'|| NVL(REQ_USER_HP,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(LAST_UDATE,' ') AS LAST_UDATE, NVL(LAST_UTIME,' ') AS LAST_UTIME, NVL(BIGO,' ') AS HD_REMARK FROM KEP_PO01 WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEP_PO01 SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
